info.album: Mellon Collie And The Infinite Sadness (Deluxe Edition)

podcast.body: The music video for "Tonight, Tonight," from *Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness*, was an elaborate homage to Georges Méliès's 1902 silent film *A Trip to the Moon*. It featured complex turn-of-the-century costumes, a group flying to the moon in a zeppelin, extensive set design, and post-production work. While its exact cost was never revealed, it was estimated to be close to $2 million, with a significant portion allocated to costumes that had to be custom-made because James Cameron had rented nearly all available old-timey costumes for *Titanic* concurrently. "The premise was an homage to a trip to the moon, a 1902 silent film by Frenchman Georges Melaise."
